---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Please describe the current behavior and how this feature would improve it.

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like in detail. Include:

- How should it work?
- What should the user experience be?
- Are there any alternatives you considered?

## Use Cases
Describe specific use cases for this feature. Examples help us understand the context and importance.

## Priority
How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Blocking my work
- [ ] High - Very important for my use case
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas
If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, please describe them here.
